obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be mounted to the propulsion and guidance system, by a torque limiting joint
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be mounted to the propulsion and guidance system, by a torque limiting joint.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is perpendicular to the axis of the guidance system, with a tolerance of ± 2°, with the joint friction torque set to a minimum of 650 Nm but no more than 850 Nm
obligations.ears: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is perpendicular to the axis of the guidance system, with a tolerance of ± 2°, with the joint friction torque set to a minimum of 650 Nm but no more than 850 Nm.

values.raw: a minimum of 650 Nm but no more than 850 Nm

derived.text: The torque limiting joint shall be set so that the longitudinal axis of the front member is perpendicular to the axis of the guidance system, with a tolerance of ± 2°.
The torque limiting joint shall be set with the joint friction torque set to a minimum of 650 Nm but no more than 850 Nm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: be fitted with low friction guides that allow the impactor to move only in the specified direction of impact
obligations.ears: When in contact with the pendulum, the guidance system shall be fitted with low friction guides that allow the impactor to move only in the specified direction of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be adjusted to give a mass of 12 ± 0.1 kg
obligations.ears: The impactor mass shall be adjusted to give a mass of 12 ± 0.1 kg, this mass includes those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall lie on the longitudinal centreline of the impactor, with a tolerance of ± 10 mm
obligations.ears: The centre of gravity of those parts of the impactor which are effectively forward of the torque limiting joint, including the extra masses fitted, shall lie on the longitudinal centreline of the impactor, with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be certified with previously unused foam
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be certified with previously unused foam.

obligations.subject: n5
obligations.response: not be excessively handled or deformed before, during or after fitting
obligations.ears: The impactor foam shall not be excessively handled or deformed before, during or after fitting.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be propelled horizontally at a velocity of 7.1 ± 0.1 m/s into the stationary pendulum as shown in Figure 29
obligations.ears: The impactor with the front member vertical shall be propelled horizontally at a velocity of 7.1 ± 0.1 m/s into the stationary pendulum as shown in Figure 29.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: have a mass of 3 ± 0.03 kg, a wall thickness of 3 ± 0.15 mm and an outside diameter of 150 mm +1 mm/-4 mm
obligations.ears: The pendulum tube shall have a mass of 3 ± 0.03 kg, a wall thickness of 3 ± 0.15 mm and an outside diameter of 150 mm +1 mm/-4 mm.

derived.text: The pendulum tube shall have a mass of 3 ± 0.03 kg.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The total pendulum tube length shall be 275 ± 25 mm.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be made from cold finished seamless steel (metal surface plating is permissible for protection from corrosion), with an outer surface finish of better than 2.0 micrometer
obligations.ears: The pendulum tube shall be made from cold finished seamless steel (metal surface plating is permissible for protection from corrosion), with an outer surface finish of better than 2.0 micrometer.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be suspended on two wire ropes of 1.5 ± 0.2 mm diameter and of 2.0 m minimum length
obligations.ears: The pendulum tube shall be suspended on two wire ropes of 1.5 ± 0.2 mm diameter and of 2.0 m minimum length.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.ears: The surface of the pendulum shall be clean and dry.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: be positioned so that the longitudinal axis of the cylinder is perpendicular to the front member (i.e. level), with a tolerance of ± 2°, and to the direction of impactor motion, with a tolerance of ± 2°, and with the centre of the pendulum tube aligned with the centre of the impactor front member, with tolerances of ± 5 mm laterally and ± 5 mm vertically
obligations.ears: The pendulum tube shall be positioned so that the longitudinal axis of the cylinder is perpendicular to the front member (i.e. level), with a tolerance of ± 2°, and to the direction of impactor motion, with a tolerance of ± 2°, and with the centre of the pendulum tube aligned with the centre of the impactor front member, with tolerances of ± 5 mm laterally and ± 5 mm vertically.
